02 / The studio

Good design begins
with listening.

We believe a space should do more than look beautiful. It should make everyday life better.

Nova Arhistudio brings architecture and interior design into one conversation. We work with light, proportion, and honest materials to create spaces with clarity, character, and a sense of belonging.

From the first sketch to the smallest detail, our process is collaborative, thoughtful, and guided by the people who will call a place their own.

Discover our approach

From the outside in.

Architecture

Architecture shaped around its setting and the way you live. We connect the big picture with the practical details, from spatial planning to material expression.

02

Interior design

Interiors that balance function and feeling. A considered composition of materials, furniture, light, and texture brings every room into focus.

Renovation & transformation

A fresh perspective on existing spaces. We find what is worth keeping, rethink what can work better, and connect the old with the new.
